title: Handover
description: The dispatch envelope: metadata header of a `dispatch_handover_v1` fenced block. The runtime-layer handover validator enforces the metadata contract.

executor.description: Editing source-of-truth: core/policy/executor-enum.yaml. Keep in sync.

dispatch_route.description: Editing source-of-truth: core/policy/dispatch-routes.yaml. Keep in sync.

brief_file.description: Absolute path; main thread writes via mktemp -p /tmp brief-<slug>-XXXXXX.md mode 0600.

isolation_level.description: Required, canonical isolation intent. Adapter layer translates to executor-native flags. Source of truth: core/policy/isolation-level.yaml. isolation_level:none (full machine access) is opencode-only; codex, claude, and grok reject it on all routes (their max isolation is workspace-write). For grok, workspace-write is narrowed to Grok's workspace OS profile (CWD + ~/.grok session store + temp) — see adapters/grok/isolation-map.yaml. The legacy sandbox/approval/skip_git_check fields were removed in v0.6.0 and are rejected by additionalProperties:false.

model.description: PM-facing alias OR wire id OR `default`. Aliases resolved via share/codex-model-aliases.tsv, share/claude-model-aliases.tsv, share/opencode-model-aliases.tsv, or share/grok-model-aliases.tsv depending on executor.

snapshot_file.description: Optional. Path to a PM-generated context snapshot. Agent uses it for orientation; security-sensitive fields (branch, SHA) must be re-derived from git before being acted upon.
